name: acceptTermsOfService
doc: Accept updated terms of service pushed at us after login. `termsId` comes from an updateTermsOfService update, not from -registrationTermsWithCompletion:.

name: confirmQrCodeLogin
doc: The other side of the same feature: this device is already signed in and has scanned a QR code shown by a device that wants to log in. `session` describes the device being authorised, so the confirm sheet can name it: "id" (NSNumber int64), "appName", "deviceModel", "platform", "ip", "location". Nil when the link was invalid or expired.

name: searchUserByToken
doc: Resolve a temporary link token scanned from someone else's profile QR code. `user` has "id" (NSNumber int64), "name" and "username". Nil when the token is unknown or expired.

name: chatThemeEmojiForChat
doc: The emoji theme currently applied to a chat, or nil when it uses the default one.

name: setSessionId
doc: "Use less data for calls" is NOT declared here: TGClient+Network already owns -setUseLessDataForCalls:completion:, and its auto-download settings dictionary exposes the current value under the "useLessDataForCalls" key. Use those; a second wrapper would be a duplicate category implementation. Whether an authorized session may accept incoming calls. `sessionId` comes from the active-sessions list. `completion` receives YES on success.

name: publicForwardsOfMessage
sig: - (void)publicForwardsOfMessage:(int64_t)messageId inChat:(int64_t)chatId offset:(NSString *)offset limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *forwards, NSString *nextOffset, NSInteger totalCount))completion
doc: Public channels that reposted a message, for the per-post statistics screen. Each entry is {"chat_id", "message_id", "title", "view_count"} for a message repost, or {"story_id", "sender_chat_id", "title"} for a story. Pass @"" as `offset` for the first page. `nextOffset` is empty at the end.

name: resolveBoostLink
doc: Resolves a t.me boost URL into a chat to open the boost sheet for. `chatId` is nil when the link cannot be resolved.

name: setAllHistoryAvailable
doc: Toggles history visibility for new members of a discussion group.

name: statisticsForMessage
doc: Per-post statistics. `graphs` has the same shape as the "graphs" entry of -statisticsForChat:isDark:completion:, with keys "message_interaction" and "message_reaction". Nil on failure.

name: recentlyOpenedChatsWithCompletion
doc: Chats opened lately, newest first.

name: removeTopChat
doc: Drop a chat from the top-chats suggestions.

name: searchChatList
doc: Chat-list search. `local` holds chats the user already has, `global` holds public chats found by username. Both are chat rows.

name: convertChatToBroadcastGroup
doc: Turn a channel's discussion group into a broadcast group. Irreversible; the caller must confirm with the user first.

name: inviteLinkCountsForChat
doc: How many links each other administrator made: "userId", "linkCount", "revokedLinkCount".

name: membersJoinedViaInviteLink
doc: Who joined through one link: "userId", "name", "date" (NSNumber unix time), "approverId". `total` is the full count, which can exceed the page `limit`.

name: setPreviousPhotoId
doc: Reuse a photo the chat had before, by the chatPhoto id TDLib gave it.

name: checkUsernameAvailable
doc: Whether a username may be taken, before the field is saved. `status` is one of "ok", "invalid", "occupied", "purchasable", "too_many", "unavailable" or "error", ready to pick a message from.

name: deleteMyProfilePhoto
doc: Remove one of the signed-in user's profile photos, by the id that -profilePhotosForUser:... returned in "photoId".

name: mainProfileTabForUser
doc: The same name for a user's profile, or nil when they set none.

name: myUsernamesWithCompletion
doc: Usernames of the signed-in account: "active" (NSArray of NSString, in the order they are shown), "disabled" (NSArray), "editable" (NSString, the one the Edit Profile field writes to; empty when none).

name: setMainProfileTab
doc: Which tab a profile opens on. `tab` is a bare name: "posts", "gifts", "media", "files", "links", "music", "voice" or "gifs".

name: setMyBirthdateDay
doc: Set the signed-in user's birthdate. Pass 0 for `year` when it is not shared; pass 0 for `day` to clear the birthdate entirely.

name: setMyProfilePhotoAtPath
doc: Set the signed-in user's profile photo from a local file. `isPublic` puts it on the profile everyone sees rather than only contacts.

name: suitablePersonalChatsWithCompletion
doc: Channels of yours that may be shown on your profile: "id" and "title".

name: supportContactWithCompletion
doc: Telegram's support account, for an "Ask a Question" row: "userId" (NSNumber), "chatId" (NSNumber, ready to open) and "name" (the support person's display name, may be empty). Nil when support is unavailable.

name: toggleUsername
doc: Switch one of the account's usernames on or off.

name: cancelUploadOfFile
doc: Cancel an upload started by uploadFileAtPath:. This does NOT cancel media already attached to a message being sent; for that, delete the pending message instead.

name: resetNetworkStatistics
doc: Zero the network counters.

name: uploadFileAtPath
doc: Upload a local file ahead of sending a message with it, so the send is instant. `type` is one of the TGFileType* constants. Completion gets the file dictionary; watch onFileProgress for the upload bar.

name: forumTopicRowsForChat
doc: First page of topics (up to 100), same dictionary shape as above. Convenience over the paging method; named differently from the older -forumTopicsForChat:completion: in TGClient.h, which returns fewer fields.

name: setSupergroup
doc: Turn a supergroup into a forum, or back. Requires owner rights. `hasTabs` is passed straight through and should be NO for this client.

name: bannedMembersInGroup
doc: The "Removed Users" list. Same entry shape as -membersInGroup:.

name: checkGroupUsername
doc: Ask the server whether a username can be taken for this group. `status` is "ok", "invalid", "occupied", "purchasable", "too-many" (this account already has the maximum number of public chats), "unavailable", or "error".

name: createInviteLinkInGroup
doc: Create an extra invite link. `name` may be nil, `expirationDate` is a unix time (0 = never), `memberLimit` 0 = unlimited.

name: createSupergroupWithTitle
doc: Create a supergroup or a channel. `description` may be nil. `completion` gets the new chat id, or 0.

name: createdPublicChatsWithCompletion
doc: Public chats this account has created, for the "too many public groups" screen. Each entry: "id", "title".

name: eventLogForGroup
doc: The admin event log ("Recent Actions"). Each entry: "id" (NSString, the event id, which is an int64 and would not survive as a plain number), "date", "userId", "name", "action" (the TDLib action type with the "chatEvent" prefix stripped, e.g. "MemberPromoted", "TitleChanged") and "raw" (the full action object, for actions the UI wants to detail). `query` may be nil.

name: inviteLinksInGroup
doc: Invite links of this group, either the live ones or the revoked ones.

name: joinGroupByInviteLink
doc: Join through an invite link. `chatId` is the chat to open, 0 when the group only took a join request - `requestSent` is YES in that case.

name: previewGroupInviteLink
doc: Look at a t.me invite link without joining, for the preview alert. Keys: "chatId" (0 when we are not a member yet), "title", "photoFileId" (NSNumber or nil), "description", "memberCount", "isChannel", "createsJoinRequest", "isPublic". Nil when the link is dead.

name: setChannel
doc: Link a discussion group to a channel; pass 0 to unlink.

name: setGroupChat
doc: Turn one of a supergroup's usernames on or off without losing it.

name: suitableDiscussionGroupsWithCompletion
doc: Groups this account could attach to a channel as its discussion group. Each entry: "id", "title".

name: addLocalTextMessage
doc: Insert a message into the local history without sending it anywhere. Used for optimistic echo and for local notices. `senderUserId` of 0 means the signed-in user. `completion` gets the flattened local message.

name: deleteMessagesFromUser
doc: Delete everything one member ever posted in a group.

name: messageLinkInfoForUrl
doc: Resolve a t.me message link the user tapped or pasted, so the app can jump to it. `chatId` and `messageId` are 0 when the link points nowhere we can open; `message` is the flattened target when TDLib already has it.

name: pinnedMessageIdInChat
doc: The id of the chat's currently pinned message, 0 when there is none.

name: pressInlineButtonWithData
sig: - (void)pressInlineButtonWithData:(NSString *)data onMessage:(int64_t)messageId inChat:(int64_t)chatId completion:(void (^)(NSString *text, BOOL showAlert, NSString *url))completion
doc: Press an inline keyboard button under a bot message. `data` is the button's base64 payload exactly as it arrived in the reply markup. `completion` gets the bot's answer: `text` to show, `showAlert` whether it wants a modal rather than a toast, and `url` when the button opens a page instead.

name: sendQuickReplyShortcut
doc: Send every message of a shortcut into a chat.

name: addCallStatisticsSent
doc: Fold the traffic of a finished voice call into the statistics. Call it from TGCall when a call ends; TDLib cannot see call traffic on its own. `kind` is a network-type name as in -setNetworkTypeKind:.

name: setNetworkTypeKind
doc: Tell TDLib what the device is connected to, so it can size its requests and bill data usage to the right bucket. `kind` is "none", "mobile", "mobileRoaming", "wifi" or "other"; anything else is treated as "other". Push this on every reachability change and when the app foregrounds.

name: setProxy
doc: Enable `proxyId` when `enabled` is YES, otherwise go direct. Exactly what a per-row switch needs, without the caller branching over two selectors.

name: addSavedNotificationSoundAtPath
doc: Upload a local audio file as a saved notification sound. `completion` gets the new sound in the same shape as above, or nil.

name: alertForNotification
doc: Turn a TDLib "notification" object into what a UILocalNotification needs: "title" (chat or sender name, may be empty), "body", and "chatId" (NSNumber, 0 when the notification does not point at a chat). nil when the notification carries nothing worth showing.

name: clearNotificationExceptionsForScope
doc: Reset every exception of one scope (or of all scopes when `scope` is nil) back to the default. `completion` gets the number of chats reset.

name: previewTextForPushContent
doc: One line of preview text for a TDLib PushMessageContent object, e.g. "Photo", "Voice message", or the text of a plain message. Pure function, safe to call on any queue; answers an empty string for anything unknown.

name: removeNotification
doc: Tell TDLib a notification the user has seen may be dropped. Call when a chat is opened, so the same alert does not come back after a restart.

name: removeNotificationGroup
doc: Drop every notification of a group up to and including `maxNotificationId`. Pass NSIntegerMax to clear the whole group.

name: removeSavedNotificationSound
doc: Delete a saved sound by its id.

name: savedNotificationSoundsWithCompletion
doc: Notification sounds saved on the account. Each entry: "id" (NSNumber int64, the sound_id to write into settings), "title", "duration" (NSNumber seconds), "date" (NSNumber unix time), "fileId" (NSNumber, pass to -downloadFile:completion: to preview it). Note that the server stores MP3/OGG, which iOS 6 will not play as an alert sound - previewing works in-app, but a UILocalNotification can only use a bundled CAF.

name: setReactionNotificationsSource
doc: Who may trigger a reaction or poll-vote notification. `source` and `pollVoteSource` are "all", "contacts" or "none". `soundId` is 0 for the default sound. There is no TDLib getter for these, so the UI has to keep the picked values itself (NSUserDefaults) and write the whole struct here.

name: allowUnpaidMessagesFromUser
doc: Let a user write to us for free from now on. `refund` also returns the stars they have already paid.

name: applyPremiumGiftCode
doc: Redeem a gift code on the signed-in account.

name: checkPremiumGiftCode
doc: Look up a t.me/giftcode link before applying it. `info` carries "creatorId" (NSNumber), "creationDate", "monthCount", "dayCount", "isFromGiveaway" (NSNumber BOOL), "userId" (NSNumber, who used it, 0 when unused) and "useDate" (NSNumber, 0 when unused). Nil when the code is not valid, which is what the alert should say.

name: dropOriginalDetailsOfGift
doc: Erase the "originally sent by" line from a unique gift, for a price.

name: giftPremiumWithStarsToUser
sig: - (void)giftPremiumWithStarsToUser:(int64_t)userId starCount:(long long)starCount months:(NSInteger)months text:(NSString *)text completion:(void (^)(BOOL ok))completion
doc: Gift Premium to a user, paid for with stars. `starCount` and `months` come from one row of -premiumGiftOptionsWithCompletion: (TGClient+Premium.h).

name: paidMessageRevenueFromUser
doc: Stars a given user has already paid us for messages.

name: payCardPaymentForm
sig: - (void)payCardPaymentForm:(NSDictionary *)form savedCredentialsId:(NSString *)savedCredentialsId newCredentialsData:(NSString *)newCredentialsData allowSaveCard:(BOOL)allowSave orderInfoId:(NSString *)orderInfoId shippingOptionId:(NSString *)shippingOptionId tipAmount:(long long)tipAmount completion:(void (^)(BOOL ok, NSString *verificationUrl))completion
doc: Pay a regular (card) form. Exactly one of `savedCredentialsId` and `newCredentialsData` must be set: the id of a row from the form's "savedCredentials", or a provider payment token JSON string obtained from the card entry screen. `orderInfoId` and `shippingOptionId` may be nil when the invoice does not need them. `tipAmount` is in the currency's smallest unit, 0 for none. `verificationUrl` is non-nil when the bank wants a 3-D Secure page opened before the payment completes.

name: paymentFormForMessage
doc: Payment form for an invoice sent as a message (bot invoice bubble, or a paid-media bubble). The form must be paid with one of the -pay... methods below, and it expires, so do not cache it across screens.  The form: "formId" (NSNumber int64), "isStars" (NSNumber BOOL), "starCount" (NSNumber, stars-priced forms only), "sellerBotUserId" (NSNumber), "title", "description", "photoFileId" (NSNumber or absent), "currency" (NSString, regular forms only), "totalAmount" (NSNumber, in the currency's smallest unit), "priceParts" (NSArray of {"label", "amount"}), "needsName" / "needsPhone" / "needsEmail" / "needsShippingAddress" / "isFlexible" / "canSaveCredentials" / "needsPassword" (NSNumber BOOL), "savedCredentials" (NSArray of {"id", "title"}), "savedOrderInfo" (NSDictionary or absent), "maxTipAmount" (NSNumber), "suggestedTips" (NSArray of NSNumber) and "invoice" - an opaque dictionary that must be handed straight back to the pay methods.

name: paymentReceiptForMessage
doc: Receipt of a completed payment, reached from the "payment successful" service message. Keys: "date" (NSNumber), "title", "description", "photoFileId" (NSNumber or absent), "sellerBotUserId" (NSNumber), "isStars" (NSNumber BOOL), "starCount" (NSNumber, stars receipts), "transactionId" (NSString, stars receipts), "currency", "totalAmount", "tipAmount", "priceParts", "credentialsTitle" and "shippingOption" (regular receipts).

name: refundStarPaymentWithChargeId
doc: Refund a star payment a bot of ours received. `chargeId` is the "telegram_payment_charge_id" a receipt carries. `ok` is NO on failure.

name: setPaidReactionAnonymous
doc: Change how an already-sent paid reaction is attributed.

name: unlockPaidMediaInMessage
doc: Unlock paid media in a message: fetches the form and pays it with stars in one step. `ok` is NO when the balance is short or the call failed.

name: validateOrderInfo
doc: Validate the shipping/contact details of a regular (card) form before paying. `orderInfo` takes "name", "phone", "email" and, when the form needs an address, "countryCode", "state", "city", "street1", "street2" and "postalCode". `save` asks Telegram to remember it for next time. `orderInfoId` is what -payCardPaymentForm... wants; `shippingOptions` is an array of {"id", "title", "amount"} and is empty for a non-flexible invoice.

name: clickPremiumSubscriptionButton
doc: Tell the server the subscribe button was tapped. Fire and forget.

name: giftPremiumToUser
sig: - (void)giftPremiumToUser:(int64_t)userId months:(NSInteger)months stars:(long long)stars message:(NSString *)message completion:(void (^)(BOOL ok, NSString *error))completion
doc: The durations Premium can be gifted for live in TGClient+Payments as -premiumGiftOptionsWithCompletion:; use that one, its rows carry the same month/star pairs this method needs. Gift Premium to a user, paid from this account's star balance. `stars` and `months` must be a pair taken from -premiumGiftOptionsWithCompletion:. `message` is an optional plain-text note shown with the gift, may be nil. `completion` receives YES, or NO with a server message - most commonly a "not enough stars" error.

name: isPremiumUser
doc: YES when this user object (any raw TDLib user dictionary, e.g. from an update or from -userWithId:) is a Premium user. Use it to decide whether to draw the star badge next to a name.

name: launchPrepaidGiveaway
sig: - (void)launchPrepaidGiveaway:(long long)giveawayId inChat:(int64_t)chatId winnerCount:(NSInteger)winnerCount winnersDate:(NSTimeInterval)winnersDate onlyNewMembers:(BOOL)onlyNewMembers hasPublicWinners:(BOOL)hasPublicWinners countryCodes:(NSArray *)countryCodes prizeDescription:(NSString *)prizeDescription stars:(long long)stars completion:(void (^)(BOOL ok, NSString *error))completion
doc: Start a giveaway a channel has already paid for, listed in the "prepaid" entries of -chatBoostStatusForChat:completion:. `winnersDate` is a unix date, `countryCodes` an array of two-letter NSString codes (may be nil for no restriction), `prizeDescription` may be nil. `stars` is 0 for a Premium prize giveaway and the prepaid star amount for a star giveaway. `completion` receives YES, or NO with a server message.

name: recognizeSpeechInMessage
doc: Ask the server to transcribe a voice or video note. The transcript is not returned here: it arrives as an updated message, so the bubble must re-read it with +speechRecognitionFromMessage:. `completion` receives YES when the request was accepted, or NO with a server message (a non-Premium account gets a limit error once its free quota is used).

name: speechRecognitionFromMessage
doc: Read the transcription state off a raw TDLib message dictionary holding a voice or video note. Returns a dictionary with "state" ("none", "pending", "text" or "error") and "text" (the transcript, the partial text while pending, or the error message). Never nil.

name: reportChat
doc: Report a chat, or particular messages in it, for abuse. Telegram drives this as a small wizard: call it first with a nil `optionId`, and the reply tells you what it still needs. `result` keys: "status" - "ok" (done), "options" (show the list), "text" (ask for a comment), "messages" (make the user pick messages); "title" and "options" (NSArray of {"id", "text"}) when status is "options"; "optionId" and "optional" (NSNumber BOOL) when status is "text". Nil on failure. Feed the chosen option's "id" back in as `optionId`.

name: linkOpensSavedMessages
doc: YES when `link` is a tg://saved style link, i.e. the URL handler should open Saved Messages. Completion gets NO for anything else, including errors.

name: chatAllowsMessageEditing
doc: Whether the message context menu may offer Edit / Schedule for this chat. Both are always unavailable in secret chats.

name: closeSecretChatId
doc: Terminate a secret chat. Fire and forget; the chat stays in the list in the "closed" state until it is deleted.

name: secretChat
doc: Whether a message type may be sent into this chat at all. `kind` is a TDLib InputMessageContent type name, e.g. "inputMessagePoll" or "inputMessageForwarded". Synchronous and cache-only: secret chats reject polls, checklists, forwards, stories and external-message replies, and this is the guard the attachment sheet and forward picker use so TDLib never returns an error the user cannot interpret.

name: secretChatInfo
doc: Secret chat info by secret chat id. `completion` receives nil on failure.

name: secretServiceTextForMessage
doc: Wording for the secret-chat service rows, or nil when the message is not one of them. Covers messageChatSetMessageAutoDeleteTime ("Alice set the self-destruct timer to 5 seconds") and messageScreenshotTaken ("Alice took a screenshot!"). `message` is a raw TDLib message.

name: selfDestructInfoForMessage
doc: Marking a message's content as opened is what starts the self-destruct countdown, so it must happen the moment a secret photo, voice note or video note is actually shown to the user. Without it the timer never runs and the message never expires. Use -openContentOfMessage:inChat: from TGClient+MessageContent.h, which already wraps openMessageContent. Flatten a raw TDLib message into what a self-destructing bubble needs: "isSecret"    NSNumber BOOL  media that must be hidden until tapped "isExpired"   NSNumber BOOL  content is one of the messageExpired* types "expiredText" NSString       placeholder wording for the expired bubble "ttl"         NSNumber       self-destruct time in seconds, 0 if none "immediate"   NSNumber BOOL  destroys as soon as it is viewed "remaining"   NSNumber       seconds left, 0 when the timer has not started or the message does not destruct Pure and synchronous - no network. Returns nil for a message that is not self-destructing and not expired.

name: selfDestructOptionForChat
doc: Extra key to merge into an inputMessage* dictionary to make the content self-destruct. `seconds` of 0 means "destroy as soon as viewed" (messageSelfDestructTypeImmediately), which is the only mode voice and video notes support. Returns nil when the chat is not secret, so the caller can merge unconditionally.

name: textForSecretChatNotification
doc: Notification text for an incoming secret chat request, or nil when the notification is not notificationTypeNewSecretChat. `notification` is a raw TDLib notification object.

name: attachedStickerSetsForFileId
doc: Sticker sets attached to a photo or video file, for the media viewer's "Stickers" button. Completion gets an array of sets.

name: customEmojiStickersWithIds
doc: Resolve custom emoji ids found in message text entities into stickers so they can be drawn inline. `customEmojiIds` is an array of NSNumber int64.

name: emojiCategoriesForStickers
doc: Emoji keyboard categories (Smileys, Animals, ...). Completion gets an array of { "name" : NSString, "isGreeting" : NSNumber BOOL, "icon" : sticker, "emojis" : NSArray of NSString }. Pass NO for `forStickers` to get the emoji categories, YES for the category row of the sticker panel.

name: emojiSuggestionsForText
doc: Emoji whose keyword starts with the typed text, for the ":smile" suggestion bar. Completion gets an array of { "emoji" : NSString, "keyword" : NSString }.

name: greetingStickersWithCompletion
doc: Stickers Telegram suggests for greeting someone in an empty chat.

name: keywordEmojisForText
doc: Emoji for an exact keyword, no fuzzy matching. Array of NSString.

name: setCustomEmojiStickerSet
doc: Set (or clear, with 0) the group custom-emoji pack of a supergroup.

name: setStickerSet
doc: Set (or clear, with 0) the group sticker pack of a supergroup.

name: stickerOutlineForFileId
doc: Vector silhouette of a sticker, to draw while its file downloads. Completion gets an array of closed paths; each path is an array of { "type" : @"line" | @"curve", "x", "y" } and, for curves, "c1x", "c1y", "c2x", "c2y". All coordinates are NSNumber doubles in the sticker's own width/height space.

name: addFileToDownloads
doc: Put a file on the account's download list ("Save to downloads" in a message action sheet). `chatId`/`messageId` identify the message it came from.

name: autoDownloadPresetNamed
doc: One of the three server presets - `name` is @"low", @"medium" or @"high" (anything else is treated as @"medium") - already translated into the key vocabulary -setAutoDownloadSettings:forNetworkType: expects, so a preset can be handed straight back to it. Nil on failure.

name: forgetAutoDownloadSettingsMirror
doc: Drop the mirror above, e.g. on logout.

name: resetNetworkStats
doc: Zero the network counters.

name: searchStoriesAtVenueProvider
sig: - (void)searchStoriesAtVenueProvider:(NSString *)provider venueId:(NSString *)venueId offset:(NSString *)offset limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *stories, NSString *nextOffset, NSInteger total))completion
doc: Public stories posted at a venue, as an interactive venue area links to.

name: closeChat
doc: Tell TDLib the chat left the screen. Call from viewWillDisappear:.

name: customEmojiIconsForIds
doc: Resolve custom emoji ids to drawable icons in one call, for a list screen that needs several badges at once. `ids` are NSNumber custom emoji ids. `completion` gets a dictionary keyed by the id as an NSString, each value shaped like -emojiStatusForUser:. Missing ids are simply absent.

name: privacyRuleDetail
doc: Full picture of one privacy setting, beyond the everybody/contacts/nobody scalar -privacyRule:completion: returns. `setting` is the TDLib name without the "userPrivacySetting" prefix: "ShowStatus", "ShowProfilePhoto", "ShowPhoneNumber", "ShowBio", "AllowCalls", "AllowChatInvites", "AllowFindingByPhoneNumber", "ShowLinkInForwardedMessages". Keys: "value" ("everybody" / "contacts" / "nobody"), "allowedUserIds", "restrictedUserIds", "allowedChatIds", "restrictedChatIds" (NSArray of NSNumber, possibly empty). Nil on failure.

name: setSelfOnline
doc: Publish or withdraw our own presence to peers. Call with YES from applicationDidBecomeActive: and NO from applicationDidEnterBackground:; without this our account looks permanently offline to everyone else.

name: statusInfoForUserStatus
doc: Format a raw TDLib UserStatus object (the "status" field of a user, or the "status" of an updateUserStatus) into what a subtitle shows. Keys: "text" (NSString, e.g. "online", "last seen yesterday at 21:04"), "isOnline" (NSNumber BOOL), "rank" (NSNumber, higher sorts first in a contacts list), "wasOnline" (NSNumber unix time, 0 when unknown), "isApproximate" (NSNumber BOOL - recently/week/month, no exact time), and "hiddenByMyPrivacy" (NSNumber BOOL - the exact time is withheld because the signed-in user hides their own last seen). Never nil, so a malformed status still yields a drawable subtitle.

name: applicationDownloadLinkWithCompletion
doc: Download link for this application, for the invite-friends SMS body.

name: publicLinkForStickerSetName
doc: t.me link to a sticker set by its short name. Nil on failure.

name: publicLinkForUsername
doc: t.me link to a public chat / user by username. Nil on failure.

name: chatsInFolder
doc: Chats of one folder.

name: clearCacheOfTypes
doc: Delete cached media. `kinds` are TDLib FileType names, or nil for all of them; `completion` gets the number of bytes freed.

name: languagesWithCompletion
doc: Language packs this account can use: "id" and "name". `current` is the one in use.

name: notificationsMutedForScope
doc: Notification settings are kept per scope rather than per chat: private chats, groups and channels each have their own. `scope` is "private", "groups" or "channels"; `muted` is what the switch shows.

name: premiumStateWithCompletion
doc: Premium state of the signed-in account: nil when it is not active.

name: sessionsWithCompletion
doc: Other devices signed into this account: "id", "name", "platform", "ip", "isCurrent", "lastActive".

name: userForPhone
doc: Resolve an address-book phone number to a Telegram user, or nil. Same dictionary shape as -contactsWithCompletion:.
